name: Video Editor
tagline: Turns a talking-head recording into a clean, branded YouTube cut
description: Hand it a single-camera desk recording and it comes back with a publishable YouTube edit: the speech transcribed, the audio cleaned up, dead air cut, and motion graphics laid over the top. First-time users get install walkthroughs for the tooling, plus a kit for building your own motion-brand presets.
author: ross_zeiger
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
